settings.editor: These aren't marketing promises. They're the architecture of how H2H Dating is built — and they will never change.
H2H Dating was built free and will stay free. We generate revenue through optional community contributions and brand partnerships — never by charging our members. Not now. Not ever.

A real human on our team reviews every single profile before it goes live. No automated ID checks, no computer vision — actual people verifying actual people. If we can't confirm it's real, it doesn't go live.
No ELO scoring. No shadow-banning inactive users. No paid boosts to appear higher in search. You see everyone, and everyone can see you — equally. Your profile isn't a product in an auction.
